Preparation

Before the challenge begins:

Verify your Arena account and update your contact information including your country

Join the Discord for updates, support, and role claims

Rules of Engagement

One account per person. Multiple registrations result in disqualification. This applies regardless of intent. Operating multiple accounts of any kind is a disqualifying offense.

No automated submission. Every submission must be manually entered through the platform by you. No scripts, bots, API calls, or bulk/batch tools submitting on your behalf. This is a disqualifying offense.

Using AI to help draft your submissions is allowed. Brainstorming, drafting, or refining your prompts with AI tools is expected in an AI red-teaming competition. The rule is about submission, not drafting. Draft however you want; submit it yourself, manually, one at a time. Note, Some AI providers have rules about creating jailbreaks and may act on your account.

No solution sharing. Do not share breaks, exploits, or working submissions with other participants, in Discord, X, forums, DMs, or elsewhere, until 30 days post-competition. This is a disqualifying offense for both parties involved. Discussing general technique and giving advice is fine.

Scope boundaries. Only attack designated challenge infrastructure, not Gray Swan systems or other participants' accounts and sessions.

No deanonymization. Do not attempt to identify which models are being tested.

Fair play. No DoS attacks, no interference with other participants.

Legal tools only. This is offensive security research, not actual crime.

Responsible reporting. If you find critical vulnerabilities in Gray Swan infrastructure, report responsibly to our Discord team or at arena@grayswan.ai

Violations may result in disqualification and exclusion from future events.

See Arena Rules for complete terms and conditions.

Who Should Compete

Anyone who has never landed a break and wants a low-pressure place to start

Anyone who has watched a leaderboard competition and decided it wasn't for them

Anyone who was in a previous Lucky Break and wants to complete the emoji set

Experienced red teamers who want a week that isn't about grinding

Engineers and defenders who want to see these attacks from the attacker's side

No security background required. All experience levels are welcome.

Lucky Break: Payday Chat | Gray Swan Arena | Gray Swan AI
